description: Dealer gamma-exposure key levels for a ticker: gamma flip, max pain, call wall, put wall and spot. Call wall = the strike at/above spot with the largest call gamma, put wall = the strike at/below spot with the largest put gamma; max pain is struck per expiration and max_pain_expiry names the (front) expiry it belongs to — max_pain_basis / wall_basis say which definition each field carries. Use when asked where price may pin, bounce, stall or accelerate, e.g. 'what are the gamma levels on SPY?'. session defaults to the latest trading day. Without an account and on free: SPY and QQQ; Pro: any ticker.

ticker.description: Stock or ETF ticker, e.g. NVDA, SPY, BRK.B
